defects.classification: LATENT PRODUCT DEFECT WITH NONDETERMINISTIC TRIGGER
severity_rationale: stale PPID + PID reuse can form an unbounded traversal
observed MemoryError (CI run 35565857461, attempt 1, commit b96cc06, unit (windows-latest, 3.11))
more importantly, stale ancestry can cause termination of a process that is not owned by the target process range
this is a process-isolation / safety violation
defects.reproduction: P0-OBS-001: the unmodified V1 function on synthetic snapshots — a cycle through the root never terminates; a non-cyclic stale edge selects an unrelated live process for TerminateProcess
defects.v2_frozen_acceptance_property: PID equality alone MUST NOT establish ownership. Process ownership must be established using an ownership mechanism robust against PID reuse.
defects.recurrence_rule: If V1-PF-001 recurs before WP-4.2 is complete: STOP the current phase gate and report it. Do not retry-until-green.
